component.name: Rhino on Linux
component.summary: Install and run McNeel Rhinoceros on Linux

description.p: Rhino on Linux sets up McNeel Rhinoceros with a patched Wine and DXVK, using the Rhino installer you download from McNeel with your own account. It checks your computer, installs Rhino step by step and keeps it working: open Rhino, check for updates, repair the setup or uninstall it. Plug-ins such as renderers and Grasshopper add-ons install with a double-click. An expert mode gives direct access to the Wine environment.
Not affiliated with Robert McNeel & Associates. Rhino requires a valid license.
